affected_party: QIF maintainers and adopters relying on verifier regressions
actual_problem: Core qif-package and expert-judgment verifier rules do not yet have complete retained negative fixtures, so a rule can be weakened without the test suite proving the loss

why_now: v0.4.2 is released and the accepted v0.4.x roadmap names complete core fixture coverage as the immediate v0.4.3 frontier
